outline.rationale: The user is a total database beginner aiming to build and query app databases, so the outline builds foundations first (relational model, installation/psql) then moves through the daily practical loop: schema design, relationships/joins, writing data, reading data, and wiring Postgres into app code. A final node covers constraints and basic indexing since data integrity and reasonable query performance are essential for a working app data layer, without straying into deprioritized admin topics (replication, tuning, backups, extensions). Nodes are ordered by dependency (concepts → setup → design → relationships → CRUD → app integration → correctness/speed) and kept MECE: reading vs. writing data are separated, and schema structure vs. relationships are separated to minimize overlap.
